opening.argument: The video directly promotes a recruitment structure built around a downline, team placement, and points for bringing in new members. The speaker explains, "this is how the pyramid work so if i bring people into my downline," then ties people recruited on both sides of the team to 500 points and claims that forty weekly cycles produce ten thousand dollars a week. It further promises that participants can earn a thousand dollars weekly from people placed beneath them. Viewers are urged to join quickly, with placement beneath existing members emphasized and a 48-hour deadline attached to a $99 lifetime membership. The material also describes an apparent monthly shipment payment and claims team activity will automatically fund it. These recruitment, payment, placement, and unusually large income claims establish the promotional scheme, while the record does not establish the separate BitConnect promotion and any market-prediction disclaimer does not remove them.
